newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Mozambique claims first success in war on smugglers.
newsitem.headline: Mozambique claims first success in war on smugglers.

text.p: Mozambique's new customs service said on Saturday it had scored its first major success with the seizure of a truck filled with contraband beer, whisky and cigarettes.

A mobile team from Britain's Crown Agents, which runs the customs operation, had confiscated a shipment of high-tax items which importers were allegedly trying to smuggle in without paying appropriate duties.

The paperwork for the consignment, at a depot on the outskirts of Maputo, said the truck was carrying spaghetti, but inspectors found it filled with over 11,000 litres of beer, 800,000 cigarettes and a quantity of Scotch whisky, Crown Agents said in statement.

The Maputo government has contracted the firm to run the customs service until the year 2000, and it began work on May 2. The company's first aim is to crack down on smuggling from neighbouring South Africa.

At present a bottle of smuggled Scotch whisky in a Maputo shop costs about half the price of the same bottle in a store in Scotland and smuggled South African cigarettes are said to have brought the Mozambican tobacco industry close to ruin.
